Maya Patel: Heads-up: PacificGrid wants an air-gapped POC in their gov-data center. Must have signed bundles, SBOM, offline activation with customer HSM (PKCS#11), and a max upgrade cadence of 90 days. They asked for pricing for a 1yr reserved support + packaging fee.

Ethan Liu: Quick Qs: hardware? jumpbox provided? HSM model?

Maya Patel: They have A100 v4 racks, will provide a hardened jumpbox, HSM = Thales Luna (PKCS#11).

Samir Khan: OK. We can support signed tarballs + signed activation files. Flow: we produce signed bundle -> customer stages on jumpbox -> run bootstrap that validates signatures -> activation file is uploaded and applied, writing sealed keys into HSM.

Samir Khan: Example bootstrap: ```bash
redwood-bootstrap --bundle /opt/bundles/redwood-2026-04.tar.gz \
  --activation /opt/activation/pacificgrid.sig \
  --hsm-module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so --hsm-slot 0
```

Julie Park: Security items: CycloneDX SBOM, signed SBOM attestation, CVE policy for POC, pen-test window. We can match 90-day patches but emergency CVE patches will be fast-tracked. Cert rotation can be handled via signed rotation packages.

Ethan Liu: To reduce physical media, we recommend delta updates (signed diffs). Note: offline activation signing is manual today; automating timed renewals for offline HSM will need ~2 sprints of eng work. Include as optional line item in SOW.

DeployBot: Uploaded sample artifact: https://artifacts.redwood.com/offline/pacificgrid-sample-2026.tar.gz (signed). SHA256: a1b2...9f0c

Maya Patel: Thanks. Can someone draft a quick SOW + ballpark pricing (standard vs managed) this afternoon so I can share with procurement?

Ethan Liu: I'll draft two options: Standard POC (quarterly signed deltas + remote support) and Managed POC (we automate jumpbox + 24/7 on-call for first 90 days). Ballpark placeholders will be included.

Julie Park: I'll prepare security appendix and ask for their SOC contacts and pen-test windows.

Maya Patel: Scheduling 30m sync with PacificGrid infra + security tomorrow 10am PT. Invite incoming. :thumbsup:
